mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, quantity, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, product_id AS productId, quantity, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + #{quantity}
